The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to cut [[log]]s into usable pieces.  In order to be available for crafting in the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} logs must be placed in a [[timber stockpile]].  It is rendered obsolete by the [[Saw|Circular Saw]].

Horizontal and vertical : 4 X 3

Rotation : No
